title: Quick check: React Compiler

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “React Compiler”?
options: Automatic memoization should be optimized only after measurement demonstrates a meaningful bottleneck.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
questions.answer_key: Automatic memoization should be optimized only after measurement demonstrates a meaningful bottleneck.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in React Compiler: Automatic memoization should be optimized only after measurement demonstrates a meaningful bottleneck.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Automatic memoization?
options: Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Profile a representative use case before adding memoization or restructuring code.
questions.answer_key: Profile a representative use case before adding memoization or restructuring code.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in React Compiler: Profile a representative use case before adding memoization or restructuring code.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “React Compiler” complete?
options: Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in React Compiler: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
